expectations.text: Recommends a Display Page Template for the 40 policy pages
States that a Page Template is copied at creation and later edits do not propagate
Mentions a collection (or similar index) for listing the policies
Cites guide locations as page.html#anchor (e.g. templates.html#display)
expectations.evidence: cites 'src/templates.html (sections #display and #pagetemplate)' as a closing list, no page#anchor links inline

expectations.text: Labels any claim not from the guide as such (or makes no out-of-guide claims)
Ends by offering to build/demo it in the local Liferay
